coverage: Republic of Ireland only: three regional assembly areas, all 31 county/city local authorities and all 100 municipal, borough and metropolitan districts in Tailte Éireann 2026. The six Dublin-area and standalone city councils without municipal districts remain valid terminal council pages. Full local source detail is retained; all parent levels dissolve from one topology. Population is the 2022 Census, with Cork city/county separated using the CSO joint census publication. No estimates are assigned to municipal districts, and Northern Ireland remains within the United Kingdom page. Ireland has no overseas territories.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
